summary: SurgePays filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026, disclosing a September 7 Asset Purchase Agreement to sell its ClearLine engagement platform and GPOX Wireless business to GPO Plus subsidiary ClearLine Apps, LLC. Consideration is $27.5 million payable solely in 25,000,000 GPO Plus Series D Preferred shares, convertible 1:1 into common with no voting or dividend rights. A concurrent Put Agreement with Emerald Shoals grants SurgePays the right to sell those shares for $27.5 million over three years and 90 days post-closing, backstopping value. Watch GPO Plus share liquidity, conversion overhang, and put exercise risk.
